title: THE ORACLE REFUSES A MANUAL JOURNAL ENTRY WHOSE LEG POINTS AT AN ACCOUNT THAT FORBIDS MANUAL ADJUSTMENTS. A2-346 debited GL 18 -- "No Manual Entries Asset", manual_journal_entries_allowed = false -- and the oracle returned HTTP 403 with error.msg.glJournalEntry.invalid.account.manual.adjustments.not.permitted. The request is otherwise BALANCED, which is what makes it a clean test of the permission rule alone.
_note: WHAT THIS VECTOR GRADES: that the port READS acc_gl_account.manual_journal_entries_allowed and refuses on it. The flag is a column a port can adopt from Fineract's schema and then never read, which is exactly the wrong implementation this vector kills. THE CHART ROW IS DATA (DEC-2 §4.5) and is transcribed into request.accounts from the A2-15 re-run of sql/q4-a2-26-ledger-state.sql, where GL 18 reads manual_journal_entries_allowed = f; the RULE is what the port supplies. WHAT IT DOES NOT SETTLE, stated rather than left to be assumed: the PRECEDENCE between this refusal and the unbalanced refusal is [UNVERIFIED]. This request is balanced and A2-344's legs are both on manual-permitted accounts, so no captured request violates BOTH rules and nothing in this corpus can order them. A port that checks them in the other order passes both of these vectors. NO BALANCE IS GRADED. acc_gl_journal_entry carries office_running_balance and organization_running_balance, and GATE G-12 IS OPEN on exactly them: A2-29 MEASURED them to be a SECOND SOURCE OF TRUTH rather than a cache -- made to disagree with the derived sum by MNT 2,000,000.00 on the live oracle, surviving four organisation-wide recomputes, propagating into a freshly computed row because the recompute seeds from its own prior output, and served at the contract boundary flagged runningBalanceComputed: true. This vector's schema has NO FIELD for either column, the capture it cites was taken without runningBalance=true, and /glaccounts?fetchRunningBalance=true is HTTP 500 on PostgreSQL anyway (GLAccountReadPlatformServiceImpl.java:127-131 emits MySQL-only 'group by ... desc'). Balances are DERIVED, never written, and never read back.

provenance.rerun_invariant: Re-posting A2-346's body while GL 18 still carries manual_journal_entries_allowed = false must return HTTP 403 with error.msg.glJournalEntry.invalid.account.manual.adjustments.not.permitted. If the flag is flipped on GL 18 the request becomes legal and this vector is false -- it must then be re-captured on a different account, not exempted.
provenance.citation: A2-15. Status 403 from the .status artefact; code and message from errors[0] of the captured body, whose args carry the account name "No Manual Entries Asset".

refusal.message: Target account does not allow manual adjustments

graded_against.note: A port that never reads manual_journal_entries_allowed posts the entry the oracle refused with 403.
